title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
description:
`tokens` is an arithmetic expression in reverse Polish (postfix) notation: each token is an integer or one of `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, and an operator applies to the two values before it.

Return the value of the expression. Division truncates toward zero. The expression is valid, never divides by zero, and every intermediate value fits in a 32-bit signed integer.

### Input
- Line 1: `tokens`, space-separated words.

### Output
One integer.

### Constraints
- `1 <= tokens.length <= 10^4`
- Numbers are in `[-200, 200]`

<?php

function solve(array $tokens): int {
    // Return the value of the postfix expression.
    return 0;

function line(array $lines, int $i): string {
    return rtrim($lines[$i] ?? "", "\r");
}

function readWords(string $s): array {
    return preg_split('/\s+/', trim($s), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

$lines = explode("\n", stream_get_contents(STDIN));
